messages:
anya: PR up for quickstart refresh: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — focuses on hello-world onboarding + auth edgecases and a tiny first-deploy Docker example. PTAL and call out any gaps.

sam: skimmed — looks good. one nit: Dockerfile snippet uses WRONG_API_KEY env name. I can push a fix.

elena: can we include both user API_KEY flow and service_account flow? enterprise teams ask about SA keys a lot.

mohit: agree on SA example. suggest a short snippet: `gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file=sa.json && export RW_SERVICE_KEY=$(cat sa.json)` then show `--header 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_TOKEN'` exchange.

ryan: also we should show the region header for private vs hosted endpoints: `x-redwood-region: us-west1` — small callout near the endpoint examples.

docs-bot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.dev (checks: lint, linkcheck, smoke)

sam: pushed Dockerfile env-name fix: use `ARG REDWOOD_API_KEY` then `ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY` in example. also fixed a broken curl sample.

anya: thanks @sam. @elena i'll draft the SA section and a short note about TTL differences. who can review language for the SA security callouts?

elena: i can review later today. add a 1-2 sentence note comparing hosted API keys (short TTL) vs SA keys (longer, but don't bake into images).

mohit: add a sidebar warning: do NOT embed SA keys in build artifacts — recommend runtime secret injection + KMS/HSM mention. keep it brief.

anya: good point — i'll add a TODO link to a migration/security guide: /docs/migration/auth-harden (placeholder)

ryan: heads up CI failing on quickstart.md lint at line 78 (trailing whitespace). i'll do a tiny commit to fix.

sam: once CI green we can merge — aiming EOD. :+1:

anya: merging after green. thanks all! :tada: If anything breaks in the preview ping me and i'll revert quick.
